pages.text: A bronze powered rail storing 5,000 FE, for carts with the [[energy_upgrade]].

**Filling:** it draws from a [[charging_station]] or [[substation]] within **2 chunks**, or from a [[heat_turbine|turbine]] or another mod's generator **right next to it**, up to 1,000 FE per tick.

**Charging:** it passes up to 1,000 FE per tick into an energy-upgraded cart on it.

**Stopping:** unpowered it holds carts still, so the locomotive stops and charges; power it to send the cart on.
